capabilities.name: account-rotation
capabilities.purpose: Switch coding-agent accounts on a usage/rate limit or to spread swarm lanes. Routes by host+agent: macOS+Claude via claude-acct; Codex/Gemini and Linux/WSL via caam.

capabilities.name: agent-mail
capabilities.purpose: Use when coordinating agents with Agent Mail locks, inboxes, threads, and conflict-prevention handoffs.

capabilities.name: agent-native
capabilities.purpose: Make an out-of-session agent AgentOps-native with skills, the ao CLI, and CI instead of hooks.

capabilities.name: autodev
capabilities.purpose: Manage the PROGRAM.md/AUTODEV.md contract consumed by evolve/factory ticks. Use for loop rules, boundaries, or PROGRAM.md repair.

capabilities.name: automation-shape-routing
capabilities.purpose: Front door for agent automation — decide the SHAPE (Workflow vs ATM vs skill), then hand off. Triggers: "build automation", "convert skills to workflows", "which shape".

capabilities.name: beads
capabilities.purpose: Track issues with bd/br, triage with bv, and convert plans to beads.

capabilities.name: beads-workflow
capabilities.purpose: Use when converting markdown plans into br beads with dependencies for implementation or swarm execution.

capabilities.name: cass
capabilities.purpose: Mine past agent sessions for working prompts, decisions, and patterns. Use when "what did I ask?", "find that prompt", session archaeology, or agent history.

capabilities.name: cc-hooks
capabilities.purpose: Configure Claude Code hooks (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, Notification). Fold target for the cc-* loop, subagent, and worktree-isolation skills.

capabilities.name: council
capabilities.purpose: Run multi-judge consensus. Use when: an irreversible or high-stakes decision needs independent judges before committing — architecture forks, one-way doors, scoring options.

capabilities.name: curate
capabilities.purpose: Mine transcripts, .agents, bd, and git for skill diffs, bd updates, or

capabilities.name: discovery
capabilities.purpose: Create dense execution packets. Fold target for brainstorm + design (goal clarification, product-fit pressure testing).

capabilities.name: doc
capabilities.purpose: Generate and validate repo docs, READMEs, and OSS doc packs.

capabilities.name: domain
capabilities.purpose: Canonical vocabulary for human-AI software work. Use when naming concepts, resolving terminology disputes, or establishing shared domain language across agents and docs.

capabilities.name: eval-outcomes
capabilities.purpose: Grade agent or model output against Outcomes for holdout-safe evals and runtime comparisons. Fold target for scenario.

capabilities.name: post-mortem
capabilities.purpose: Review completed work and learn. Use when: a task, PR arc, or session is finished and you want to extract learnings, or after ≥5 PRs (the scope checkpoint).

capabilities.name: pre-land-refuters
capabilities.purpose: Dispatch unbiased parallel refuters (fresh Fable + read-only codex exec) to attack a completion claim before landing a large change. Triggers: pre-land validation, refute before push.

capabilities.name: pre-mortem
capabilities.purpose: Stress-test plans before work. Use when: a plan is drafted but not yet executed and you want to surface failure modes, risks, and what would prove it wrong before committing.

capabilities.name: rch
capabilities.purpose: Use when offloading slow builds to remote workers or recovering RCH worker, hook, SSH, sync, or disk issues.

capabilities.name: red-team
capabilities.purpose: Probe docs and skills. Use when: adversarially probing a doc, skill, plan, or claim for weaknesses, gaps, or unstated assumptions before it ships.

capabilities.name: review
capabilities.purpose: Review diffs for risk, find mocks, scan for bugs, audit codebases. Fold target for bug-hunt, codebase-audit, and ubs.

capabilities.name: scaffold
capabilities.purpose: Create project, component, or boilerplate scaffolds. Use when starting a new project, module, or component, generating boilerplate, or stamping a repeatable file structure.

capabilities.name: scope
capabilities.purpose: Hard-block edits outside declared frozen directories and protect paths during risky changes.

capabilities.name: security
capabilities.purpose: Run repository security scans for vulnerabilities, dependency risk, secrets, and release gates.

capabilities.name: skill-auditor
capabilities.purpose: Audit SKILL.md files against the AgentOps template and readiness checks. Use for quality reviews or template compliance.

capabilities.name: skill-builder
capabilities.purpose: Scaffold or absorb new SKILL.md files against the unified AgentOps template. Triggers: "create a skill", "scaffold skill", "absorb external skill", "new skill".

capabilities.name: using-atm
capabilities.purpose: Use ATM as the out-of-session substrate: spawn Claude/Codex panes running /rpi and /evolve over a bead queue, then tend the swarm to convergence.

capabilities.name: validate
capabilities.purpose: Produce PASS/WARN/FAIL verdicts for artifacts, plans, code, PRs, or gates — including quick readiness/sanity checks before commit (absorbs vibe) and completion audits.

capabilities.name: vibing-with-ntm
capabilities.purpose: Use when tending NTM agent swarms, unsticking panes, handling rate limits, or coordinating convergence.

capabilities.name: workflow-builder
capabilities.purpose: Scaffold a new Claude Workflow script — deterministic multi-agent orchestration. Triggers: "build a workflow", "create a workflow", "scaffold workflow", "author a workflow".
